# Link matrix

Every destination shape the resolver has to classify, in one document.

| kind | link |
| --- | --- |
| internal | [intro](guide/intro.md) |
| internal anchor | [intro anchor](guide/intro.md#getting-started) |
| anchor | [local anchor](#link-matrix) |
| external | [example](https://example.com/docs) |
| protocol relative | [cdn](//cdn.example.com/app.js) |
| mail | [mail](mailto:docs@example.com) |
| percent encoded | [spaced](guide/my%20notes.md) |
| asset | ![logo](assets/logo.svg) |
| duplicate asset | ![logo again](assets/logo.svg) |
| missing document | [missing](missing.md) |
| escaping asset | ![outside](../outside.png) |
